div.h1: D15 · DictionaryNodeRegistry — stable node ids by exact path-step key

div.p: Exactness invariant: child keys pack u32 parent_id plus the 21-bit Unicode scalar value of edge_label; u64::MAX is reserved for the root. FxHashMap may collide internally, but equality checks prevent node aliasing. Read/write access is guarded by RwLock; crate-local helpers recover poisoned guards with PoisonError::into_inner().
